content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Lawrenceville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of formal project management education — no prior work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-career professionals in Lawrenceville's growing healthcare, government, education, and logistics sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Study the PMBOK® Guide framework, processes, and best practices entirely online at your own pace. Our structured curriculum meets PMI's education requirement so you can move directly to certification.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and complete your CAPM application, documenting your secondary degree and course completion. Pay the exam fee and await PMI's approval. Granite PM Academy guides you through each step to ensure your application meets all PMI requirements.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources — practice questions, study guides, and strategy sessions — to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. Active certified practitioners lead our prep sessions to clarify complex concepts and refine your test-taking approach.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through PMI-approved activities, continuing education, or volunteer work. Renew by submitting your PDUs before expiration to keep your credential active and demonstrate ongoing project management commitment.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
